title: Audience Phase Briefing Canvas — lightweight rollforward composer
creator: Claire Zhao
description:
Purpose: Explore a lightweight briefing canvas that helps operators construct a rollforward (controlled increase in traffic) targeted to audience phases. The canvas emphasizes explainable heuristics (why we chose an audience, why the ramp size), quick guardrails (auto-suggested safety gates), and a runtime cost preview for each ramp step. This prototype is intentionally minimal compared to previous full-blown composers: goal is to validate whether a condensed briefing UX can reduce setup time for small-to-medium experiments without sacrificing safety.

Scope: Canvas-level flow that sits upstream of the detailed rollout composer: select audience segments (predefined cohorts), choose phase durations and ramp percentages, review auto-suggested safety gates (error budget threshold, latency thresholds, regression delta), and simulate a traffic ramp using synthetic telemetry presets. Not in scope: full A/B metrics dashboard, advanced cohort builder, or backend routing implementation.

Design principles: 1) Minimal cognitive load per step; 2) Make defaults opinionated but reversible; 3) Surface cost tradeoffs per step; 4) Keep rollback paths explicit and discoverable.

Key artifacts: Figma mockups, brief script for usability testing, simulation harness (frontend-only), and a Confluence PRD with acceptance criteria and safety rationale.
acceptance_criteria: Operator can create a briefing and produce a 3-step rollforward plan (phase A/B/C) within 3 minutes in the prototype
Canvas shows per-step cost delta (estimated tokens and GPU minutes) and cumulative cost before commit
Auto-suggested safety gates appear with explainable rationale and can be toggled on/off
Simulation mode animates traffic distribution and surfaces synthetic SLO breaches for operator review
Design handoff assets (Figma frames + annotated behavior spec) are ready for Engineering intake
engineering_notes: Minimal API footprint: prototype will call existing /rollouts/simulate endpoint with a 'briefing' flag; if missing, simulate client-side using canned telemetry
Need a lightweight telemetry preset library (error-rate, latency, token-distribution) mapped to each audience to demo expected regressions
We should avoid introducing new routing primitives in the backend for prototype; plan to translate briefing -> detailed rollout spec at commit time via transformation service
